• The bill creates a new right allowing a person who is worried to obtain information about an intimate partner who may pose a risk to their safety.
  • It establishes a comprehensive process involving the Sûreté du Québec and a designated body to handle these requests and disclose the information.
  • New act respecting the disclosure of information: a person at risk, or someone acting on their behalf with their consent, may request information about their intimate partner.
  • New act: a minor aged 14 or over may submit such a request on their own.
  • New act: the government may, by regulation, designate other persons or categories of persons who may submit a request.
  • New act: police officers and workers from support organizations may inform a person at risk about the request process if it could benefit them.
  • New act: a police officer may, in these cases, disclose the identity of the partner who is the subject of a possible request.
  • New act: the Sûreté du Québec conducts the searches and transmits the relevant information to a body designated by the minister responsible for the status of women.
  • New act: a designated person, subject to regulatory conditions, meets with the person at risk to verbally communicate the information or the absence of relevant information.
  • New act: this person may also direct the person at risk to specialized resources and provide additional information.
  • New act: restrictions govern the disclosure to the intimate partner of the existence of a request and personal information concerning them.
  • New act: rules limit the further communication and use of the information obtained.
  • New act: certain persons benefit from immunity for acts performed in the exercise of their duties related to this process.
  • New act: these persons cannot be compelled to testify before a court concerning this information.
  • New act: penal offences are provided for breaches of the rules on communication or use of information.
  • Act respecting the Québec correctional system: revises the rules on disclosing to victims information concerning incarcerated persons or those under the supervision of correctional services.
  • Act respecting the Ministère de la Sécurité publique: consequential adjustments related to the creation of the new information disclosure regime.
